summary: Revised implementation plan for Careme Wanki's quiet-luxury real estate brand platform. Fully addresses all user review points: eliminates simulated appointments in favor of honest consultation requests, enforces zero fabricated testimonials for compliance, clarifies sample listing provenance, stores headshot and brand assets locally in /public/images, adds comprehensive SEO and RealEstateAgent Schema.org structured data, implements a robust Next.js /api/contact backend, and specifies sitemap, robots.txt, accessibility, and mobile navigation behavior.
